title: SectionViewStyle group-3 label attachment/alignment overlay insertion
scope: Preserve typed SectionViewStyle label attachment and alignment values when raw group-3 code-90 occurrences are absent
Exercise the second group-3 long with a default first-slot placeholder
Verify ordered raw replay and typed same-version readback

production: The same-version overlay inserts missing group-3 code-90 attachment/alignment values when typed values differ from defaults.
A changed alignment with a default/missing attachment value emits the signed DXF-long placeholder first, preserving the reader's two-occurrence mapping.
tests: Generated ASCII and Binary controls remove both group-3 code-90 values, retain the default attachment, and change alignment.
The focused style selector checks the exact expected raw stream and same-version readback while retaining the adjacent group-3 double and group-2 color/weight controls.

limitations: This verifies local generated same-version raw overlay and typed readback only. It does not qualify the group-code sequence against a native producer, cross-version serialization, or CAD display behavior.
